# Sunstone

> Sunstone is an open-source (MIT) markdown editor for folders of .md files in git, with first-class support for the Open Knowledge Format (OKF). It runs as a desktop app on Linux, macOS and Windows, in the browser via `npx sunstone-md`, and as a self-hosted Docker image (Sunstone Web) that commits every save and syncs with a git remote.

Key facts:

- Opens any folder of markdown (`sunstone ./docs`); writes nothing into it except your edits. Settings live in `~/.config/sunstone/`.
- Wikilinks (`[[Page]]`, `[[Page#Heading]]`, `[[Page|text]]`) and markdown links; renaming or moving a file rewrites every link to it.
- Live preview, backlinks, outline, tags, full-text search, Mermaid/D2/PlantUML diagrams rendered locally, PDF export, a tiling workspace.
- Git review: the working copy against `HEAD` as inline track changes, and a file's history.
- Review comments stored inline as CriticMarkup (`{==text==}{>>note<<}`).
- OKF v0.2: trust and status pill, frontmatter checked against the spec, sources cited with footnotes, `sunstone lint` for CI.
- Compared to Obsidian: no vault or plugin API, sync and publishing through git and a self-hosted Docker image, MIT instead of proprietary, no mobile app (the web reader has a phone layout).
- Built with Tauri 2, SvelteKit and Rust.

Every page of the user guide is also available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`, or as JSON (frontmatter, body, links, backlinks) with `Accept: application/json`.

## Docs

- [Sunstone User Guide](https://wiki.sunstone.md/)
- [Install](https://wiki.sunstone.md/1-getting-started/install): Desktop installers for macOS, Windows and Linux, and how Sunstone keeps itself up to date.
- [Open a folder](https://wiki.sunstone.md/1-getting-started/open-a-folder): Launch Sunstone on any directory of markdown from the command line or the launcher.
- [Run in the browser](https://wiki.sunstone.md/1-getting-started/run-in-browser): Use Sunstone without installing it with npx sunstone-md, or serve the desktop editor with sunstone serve.
- [Comments](https://wiki.sunstone.md/2-editing/comments): Margin comments stored as CriticMarkup inside the file.
- [Diagrams](https://wiki.sunstone.md/2-editing/diagrams): Mermaid, D2 and PlantUML code blocks rendered as diagrams.
- [Footnotes and sources](https://wiki.sunstone.md/2-editing/footnotes-and-sources): Footnotes, cited sources and their hover cards.
- [Frontmatter](https://wiki.sunstone.md/2-editing/frontmatter): Edit a Concept's YAML frontmatter in place, with folding and OKF-aware checks.
- [Images](https://wiki.sunstone.md/2-editing/images): Embed images from the Bundle inline.
- [Links](https://wiki.sunstone.md/2-editing/links): Wikilinks and markdown links, heading anchors, folder links, and links that follow a rename.
- [Live preview](https://wiki.sunstone.md/2-editing/live-preview): Source, Live and Read modes, formatting shortcuts and in-file find and replace.
- [Export as PDF](https://wiki.sunstone.md/2-editing/pdf-export): Print preview and PDF export of a Concept.
- [Explorer](https://wiki.sunstone.md/3-navigating/explorer): The folder tree: titles or filenames, keyboard control, drag and drop, and the Bundle root.
- [Outline and backlinks](https://wiki.sunstone.md/3-navigating/outline-and-backlinks): The headings of the current Concept and everything that links to it.
- [Search](https://wiki.sunstone.md/3-navigating/search): Full-text search, quick navigation and tags.
- [Tiling workspace](https://wiki.sunstone.md/3-navigating/tiling-workspace): Several Concepts side by side in columns and tiles.
- [Review changes](https://wiki.sunstone.md/4-git/review-changes): Compare your edits with the last commit and step through a file's history.
- [Git-synced wiki](https://wiki.sunstone.md/5-web/git-synced-wiki): Back a Sunstone Web deployment with a git remote so browser edits and pushes reconcile on their own.
- [Reading API](https://wiki.sunstone.md/5-web/reading-api): Fetch any page as Markdown or JSON, list a folder, or search, from scripts and agents.
- [Sunstone Web](https://wiki.sunstone.md/5-web/sunstone-web): Serve a Bundle in any browser from a Docker image: read-only for visitors, the full editor for signed-in users.
- [Lint a Bundle](https://wiki.sunstone.md/6-okf/lint): Check a Bundle's links, footnotes, Frontmatter and OKF conformance from the command line with sunstone lint.
- [OKF support](https://wiki.sunstone.md/6-okf/okf-support): What Sunstone understands about OKF bundles: validation, trust, lifecycle, sources and attested computations.
- [Fonts](https://wiki.sunstone.md/7-customize/fonts): Choose the fonts and sizes for the interface, text, headings and code, optionally from font files.
- [Theme colours](https://wiki.sunstone.md/7-customize/theme-colors): Override the base colours of the light and dark schemes.
